name: Pashupatinath Temple
description: One of the holiest Hindu temples in the world, dedicated to Lord Shiva, located on the banks of the Bagmati River. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a major pilgrimage destination.
famous_for: Sacred Shiva temple, cremation ghats, UNESCO World Heritage Site

name: Swayambhunath Stupa
description: An ancient self-arisen Buddhist stupa perched atop a hill, popularly known as the Monkey Temple due to the holy monkeys living there. Offers panoramic views of the Kathmandu Valley.
famous_for: Ancient Buddhist stupa, monkeys, panoramic valley views

name: Boudhanath Stupa
description: One of the largest spherical stupas in the world, a major center of Tibetan Buddhism surrounded by monasteries and prayer flags.
famous_for: Largest stupa in Nepal, Tibetan Buddhist culture

name: Kathmandu Durbar Square
description: The historic royal palace complex of the old Kathmandu Kingdom, featuring intricately carved temples, courtyards and the residence of the Kumari (Living Goddess).
famous_for: Royal palace complex, Kumari Ghar, ancient Newari architecture

name: Patan Durbar Square
description: The old royal palace of the Malla kings of Lalitpur, renowned for its exquisite stone and wood carvings and Newari craftsmanship.
famous_for: Malla-era palace, Krishna Mandir, Patan Museum

name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site showcasing the finest medieval art and architecture of the Malla dynasty in the ancient city of Bhaktapur.
famous_for: 55 Window Palace, Golden Gate, medieval Newari art

name: Changu Narayan Temple
description: Believed to be the oldest surviving Hindu temple in the Kathmandu Valley, dedicated to Lord Vishnu, adorned with stone, wood and metal artwork.
famous_for: Oldest Hindu temple in Nepal, ancient stone inscriptions

name: Nyatapola Temple
description: A five-story pagoda temple in Bhaktapur, the tallest in Nepal, dedicated to the goddess Siddhi Lakshmi and famed for its earthquake-resistant design.

name: Dattatreya Temple
description: A 15th-century temple in Bhaktapur dedicated to Dattatreya, said to be built from the wood of a single tree, showcasing exceptional wood carving.
famous_for: Single-tree wood carving legend, ancient architecture

name: Kumari Ghar
description: The palace residence of the Kumari, Nepal's Living Goddess, located near Kathmandu Durbar Square, featuring beautifully carved windows.
famous_for: Home of the Living Goddess Kumari

name: Garden of Dreams
description: A neo-classical historic garden in the heart of Kathmandu, offering a peaceful retreat with fountains, pavilions and manicured lawns.

name: Thamel
description: Kathmandu's vibrant tourist hub packed with hotels, restaurants, souvenir shops, trekking gear stores and nightlife.

name: Narayanhiti Palace Museum
description: The former royal palace of the Shah dynasty, now converted into a museum displaying royal artifacts, thrones and photographs.
famous_for: Former royal palace, Shah dynasty history

name: Asan Bazaar
description: A centuries-old bustling market square in Kathmandu, famous for spices, textiles and local street food surrounded by ancient temples.
famous_for: Historic bazaar, spices and local goods

name: Freak Street
description: A historic alley near Basantapur that was a famous hippie hangout in the 1960s and 70s, still retaining its bohemian charm.

name: Chandragiri Hills
description: A scenic hill accessible by cable car offering panoramic views of the Kathmandu Valley and the Himalayan range including Mount Everest on clear days.

name: Shivapuri National Park
description: A protected forested national park north of Kathmandu, popular for hiking, birdwatching and as the watershed for the valley's rivers.

name: Nagarkot
description: A hill station east of Bhaktapur renowned for spectacular sunrise and sunset views over the Himalayan range.

name: Dakshinkali Temple
description: A significant Hindu temple dedicated to the fierce goddess Kali, known for its traditional animal sacrifice rituals performed on Tuesdays and Saturdays.

name: Budhanilkantha Temple
description: An open-air shrine featuring a massive stone statue of Lord Vishnu reclining on a bed of serpents in a water pond.

name: Chabahil Stupa
description: An ancient Buddhist stupa believed to predate Boudhanath, located at a busy junction in eastern Kathmandu.

name: Ichangu Narayan Temple
description: One of the four Narayan temples surrounding the Kathmandu Valley, set in a quiet forested hillside dedicated to Lord Vishnu.
famous_for: One of the four valley Narayan temples

name: Ranipokhari
description: A historic artificial pond in the center of Kathmandu built by King Pratap Malla, with a temple at its center.

name: Kirtipur
description: A hilltop Newari town near Kathmandu known for its well-preserved medieval architecture, weaving industry and panoramic views.

name: Bagh Bhairab Temple
description: A striking temple in Kirtipur dedicated to Bhairab in the form of a tiger, decorated with swords and shields from historic battles.

name: Taudaha Lake
description: A semi-natural lake south of Kathmandu believed in legend to be the former abode of serpent deities, popular for birdwatching.

name: Godavari Botanical Garden
description: A large botanical garden at the base of Phulchowki hill housing diverse plant species, greenhouses and a peaceful arboretum.

name: Phulchowki Hill
description: The highest hill rim of the Kathmandu Valley, renowned among birdwatchers and hikers for its rich biodiversity and mountain views.

name: Bungamati
description: A traditional Newari village south of Patan known as the birthplace of Rato Machindranath and its wood-carving heritage.

name: Khokana
description: A well-preserved traditional Newari village famous for its mustard oil production and vernacular architecture.

name: Rato Machindranath Temple
description: A revered pagoda temple in Bungamati/Patan dedicated to Rato Machindranath, celebrated with one of Nepal's longest chariot festivals.

name: Kumbheshwar Temple
description: A five-tiered pagoda temple in Patan dedicated to Lord Shiva, one of the oldest temples in the city with a sacred pond.

name: Mahaboudha Temple
description: A unique terracotta temple in Patan built entirely of carved clay bricks depicting images of the Buddha, styled after Bodh Gaya.

name: Golden Temple
description: Hiranya Varna Mahavihar, a 12th-century Buddhist monastery in Patan famed for its gilded facade and intricate metalwork.

name: Patan Museum
description: A museum housed within the Patan Durbar complex displaying an extensive collection of traditional bronze and metal religious artifacts.

name: Central Zoo Jawalakhel
description: Nepal's only zoo, home to a variety of native and exotic wildlife including Bengal tigers, rhinos and rare bird species.

name: Krishna Mandir
description: A stone temple in Patan Durbar Square built entirely of carved stone in Shikhara style, dedicated to Lord Krishna.

name: Vatsala Devi Temple
description: A stone temple in Bhaktapur Durbar Square known for its bronze bell used historically to sound curfew and emergencies.

name: 55 Window Palace
description: A magnificent brick palace in Bhaktapur Durbar Square famed for its fifty-five intricately carved wooden windows.

name: Pottery Square
description: A lively square in Bhaktapur where local artisans shape and dry traditional clay pottery using centuries-old techniques.

name: Taumadhi Square
description: A historic square in Bhaktapur adjoining Nyatapola Temple, lined with traditional restaurants and temples.

name: Namobuddha
description: A significant Buddhist pilgrimage site where, according to legend, the Buddha offered his body to a starving tigress in a past life.

name: Sundarijal
description: A scenic waterfall and starting point for the Shivapuri and Helambu trekking routes, popular for day hikes and picnics.

name: Vajrayogini Temple, Sankhu
description: An ancient temple in the historic town of Sankhu dedicated to the tantric goddess Vajrayogini, set amid forested hills.
famous_for: Tantric goddess shrine, historic Sankhu town

name: Gokarna Forest
description: A protected forest reserve on the outskirts of Kathmandu, home to spotted deer and known for its nature trails and golf resort.

name: Gokarneshwor Mahadev Temple
description: A sacred Shiva temple on the banks of the Bagmati River, an important site for ancestral rites and Gokarna Aunsi festival.

name: Balaju Garden
description: A historic garden known as Balaju Baisdhara, featuring twenty-two stone waterspouts and a swimming pool amid landscaped grounds.

name: Chobhar Gorge
description: A dramatic gorge where the Bagmati River cuts through the valley rim, tied to the legend of Manjushree draining the ancient lake.

name: Jal Binayak Temple
description: A revered Ganesh shrine near Chobhar Gorge, worshipped as a natural rock formation representing the elephant-headed god.

name: Champadevi Hill
description: A popular hiking hill on the southern rim of the Kathmandu Valley offering rewarding views and a small shrine at its summit.
